format: ECMAScript Module (JavaScript with ES modules syntax)
description: This file is a JavaScript module for a CLI script that compares benchmark results against a fixture. It performs command-line argument parsing, file I/O, and process execution to run benchmarks and assess regressions in duration and RSS metrics.

methods.name: formatMs

methods.name: formatMb
methods.description: Formats a numeric value into a string with one decimal point followed by 'MB'.

methods.name: resolveCurrentReportPath
methods.description: Determines the path for the current benchmark report, running a benchmark process if necessary.

methods.name: indexCases
methods.description: Transforms a report object into a Map of case IDs to case entries for easy lookup.
